repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly repeats the valve close and mail send actions in the periodic else-branch. The IR specifies a cycle that runs indefinitely but contains only the email send action; the valve close is a one-time action preceding the cycle. The candidate's else-branch duplicates the initial actions, causing extra valve closes and mail sends at every 60-second interval.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the duplicate action block from the else-branch. The IR cycle body contains only the email send, so the periodic part of the script should only execute that action. The initial wait and valve close remain in the phase-0 block as required.
